name: Rogue Drone Patrol
desc: A malfunctioning scrap drone is harassing the neighborhood. Take it out.
flavor: It's been stealing parts from Grandpa's sorting station for weeks.

name: Rogue Labor Containment
desc: An industrial Labor has gone haywire near the docks. Corporate wants it stopped — quietly.
flavor: Whoever corrupted its BIOS knew what they were doing.

name: Salvage Run: Sector 7
desc: Standard sweep through the outer ring. Drones, debris, and opportunity.
flavor: Even the junk has junk in it. Dig deeper.

name: Rogue Drone Pack
desc: A cluster of corrupted drones has taken up permanent residence near the water reclamation plant. Clear them.
flavor: They've been scrapping each other for parts. The survivors are meaner for it.

name: Rival Gang — First Contact
desc: The Ironjaw crew has been raiding your usual spots. Time for an introduction.
flavor: They fight dirty. You'll have to fight dirtier.

name: Corrupted Sentinel
desc: Something ancient is waking up in the deep scrapyard. It doesn't like visitors.
flavor: The serial number dates back forty years. Whatever it was built to protect... it still is.

name: Father's Debt — Notice
desc: An Ironjaw enforcer left a calling card at the workshop. Kenji's father owes more than scrap.

name: Steel Covenant Envoy
desc: A Steel Covenant representative wants to talk — but first, a proof of strength.
flavor: Every faction tests you. This one at least tells you up front.

name: Beyond the Perimeter
desc: Surveillance tech has been sighted past the eastern patrol boundary. Who put it there? Why? Your mech can reach it. Maybe you should.
flavor: The map says 'uncharted.' The sensor pings say otherwise.

storyBeats.log: The array bears a Taeyang Corp serial number. Corporate surveillance — here, in the wastes. Who are they watching?

debrief: The array was looking for something specific.
Taeyang knew to place it here. That means someone told them where to look.
You have their serial number. That's a thread.

narrative.speaker: kenji
briefing_pages: There's a sensor cluster past the eastern boundary. Not on any public map. I want to know who put it there.
debriefing_victory: Taeyang Corp. Their insignia, their serial numbers, their frequency bands. This isn't random. Someone built this to watch this district.
debriefing_defeat: They pushed you back. But you saw the logo on that drone. Taeyang.

level1.reveals: Enemy: 2x Taeyang Drone + 1x Security Unit. Eastern approach has lower guard density.

level2.reveals: The array has a 90-second patrol reset blind spot. The real objective isn't the array — it's what's underneath it.

name: The Taeyang Contract
desc: Anonymous job. High pay. Sealed crate. Taeyang destination. You know something is wrong. But you're broke, and curiosity is expensive.
flavor: The crate is warm. It hums.

storyBeats.log: You reach the Taeyang facility. The crate is still sealed. You have a choice.

debrief: The crate was warm. Something inside was drawing power.
Behavioral modification chips. Or corporate logistics. You still don't know which.

narrative.speaker: system
briefing_pages: Anonymous employer. Sealed cargo. Taeyang destination. The pay is real. The red flags are too.
The job is simple: pick up the crate, deliver it. Don't ask what's inside.
debriefing_victory: The ambush was Rust Kings — someone tipped them off. The crate made it through. Now you have to decide what to do with it.

name: The Bounty
desc: Your mech registration appeared on a corporate bounty board. Someone wants you collected or destroyed. You need to find out who put it there — and why they think you're a threat.
flavor: You've become inconvenient. That means you found something real.

storyBeats.log: The contract traces to a shell company. Three layers deep — then a name: Taeyang Industrial Security Division. They know you exist. They know what you know.

debrief: The bounty was placed 48 hours after the Taeyang facility job.
They were already watching. The contract was insurance.
Taeyang doesn't file bounties on random scrappers.

narrative.speaker: kenji
briefing_pages: Your mech registration is on a bounty board. Corporate-tier. Someone spent serious cred to put you there.
We need to trace the contract before whoever filed it sends more than one hunter.
debriefing_victory: Taeyang Industrial Security. They flagged you the moment you touched that cargo. We're past the point of coincidence.

name: Dad's Last Route
desc: Grandpa found the maintenance log from Kazuo's last patrol. Sector 7-East. Taeyang's surveillance network runs right through it. You're going to retrace his final route.
flavor: His mech prints are still in the mud. Six years of rain and they're still there.

storyBeats.log: The mech is there. Charred from the inside. This wasn't a malfunction — this was a directed EMP. Corporate-grade. Taeyang-grade.
Grandpa reads the log silently. Then: 'He found the same thing you found. He was going to go public.' A long pause. 'They killed my son.'

debrief: Kazuo's patrol logs showed him investigating the same surveillance network — six years ago.
He sent a report. It was filed as 'unsubstantiated.' Two weeks later, equipment failure.
No failure. A murder. And a cover-up that's been running ever since.

narrative.speaker: grandpa
briefing_pages: I found his maintenance log. Sector 7-East. That's where he was the last week.
He kept notes. Detailed ones. Something out there scared him enough to write it all down. We need those notes.
debriefing_victory: It was there. Charred from the inside out. Not wear, not accident. Someone used a directed EMP at close range. Someone with corporate-grade hardware.

name: Arena Ranked
desc: Your name appeared on the bracket without your consent. Corporate-sponsored tournament. Win, and you become visible — to everyone. Lose, and you disappear.
flavor: The crowd is quiet. They've seen too many good pilots come through those gates.

storyBeats.log: Sigma-7 lies still. The crowd erupts. From the corporate box, no one applauds. A man in a Taeyang suit writes something down. You've been noticed.
You know what happened to your father. You have evidence. You have enemies. Phase 5 begins — and this time, you're not running.

debrief: You entered a corporate tournament you didn't sign up for and won.
Taeyang entered you to watch how you fight — and to discredit your evidence by making you a known arena fighter.
It didn't work. You're still standing. So is the evidence.

narrative.speaker: system
briefing_pages: Your mech registration number appeared on the tournament bracket. No notification. No consent.
Taeyang Corp is the sponsor. They picked the participants. They picked you.
Win — and everything changes. Lose — and you get to wonder what they planned for the loser.
debriefing_victory: SIGMA-7 is down. The crowd is loud. The corporate box is silent.
You did what they didn't expect. Now they know what you're capable of. So does everyone else.
debriefing_defeat: You fought SIGMA-7 and lost. But you made it to the final. The crowd saw it. People noticed.
Taeyang got what they wanted — a public loss. But you're still here. That's more than they planned for.

name: Outer District Patrol
desc: Sweep the eastern outer district. Rust King activity has been reported.
flavor: They've been bold lately. That means something changed.

name: Corporate Sector Watch
desc: Monitor Taeyang's activity in the industrial zone. Document movements.
flavor: They're rotating their patrol schedules. That means they know someone's watching.

name: Refugee District Escort
desc: Escort supply runners through the contested perimeter. No one else will do it.
flavor: They carry medicine, not weapons. The Rust Kings don't care.

name: Nephilim Salvage Team
desc: Nephilim Corp has a team stripping your zone. They won't stop unless you make them.
flavor: They weren't just salvaging. Someone hired them to look for something specific.
